svg.title: Utilities P&ID with standby pump P-4712B (based on reference.xml, DEXPI Example C01)
svg.desc: Orange = new in this revision: standby pump P-4712B with suction valve BV-6, discharge check valve CV-2 and discharge isolating valve BV-7, plus auto-start trip logic XS4712.03 / XC4712.04. Geometry uses the reference.xml coordinates (mm, Y up) flipped into SVG space.

g.text: STANDBY CHANGEOVER: P4712 TRIP → P-4712B START
Normal duty: P4712 runs, P-4712B is stopped on standby.
BV-6 and BV-7 are locked open (LO), so the standby is always ready;
CV-2 stays shut under header pressure while P4712 runs.
Trip: P4712 stops → XS4712.03 trip → XC4712.04 starts P-4712B.
47126 keeps leaving the sheet; the only gap is the P-4712B start-up (seconds).
Hour of day (illustrative: P4712 trips at 10:00)
product out of sheet via 47126, every hour
